name: Mobile JSON Wire Protocol Specification
notes: The repository holds spec-draft.md, Python WebDriver tests for finding elements in webviews, and the ApiDemos sample app. The draft extends the Selenium JSON Wire Protocol, names appium, ios-driver and selendroid as automation tools, and records that its details were worked out at meetings in August 2013.
summary: A draft WebDriver extension for automating native and hybrid mobile apps, defining sessions, capabilities, locator strategies, touch gestures, orientation, rotation, network modes and webview contexts.
